amendment_reason.detected_by: deterministic projector-only mapping pilot permitted by the parent seal
amendment_reason.problem: released backend B exponentiates displacement and squeezing after finite-Fock truncation; the resulting finite-dimensional unitary is not project-then-truncate and wraps remote comb peaks back into the retained subspace
amendment_reason.resolution: retain the released backend-B transition, channel, IQ and RNG implementation but replace only the T9.2.4 logical coordinate evaluator by an independent closed-form Hermite-Gaussian projection of the Mehler-damped comb

logical_bridge.orthonormalization: Lowdin inverse square root of the independently projected raw Gram matrix

deterministic_mapping_pilot.disclosure: A/B same-cutoff mapping agreement does not prove physical cutoff convergence; captured mass and the common cutoff submatrix remain separately gated/reported

action_and_fault_semantics.sequence_rule: repeat the declared sequence cyclically to the frozen horizon
action_and_fault_semantics.intervention_rule: add the scenario drift_delta to the current causal drift immediately before the declared round(s), then propagate normally; actions never observe scenario identity or hidden drift
action_and_fault_semantics.telegraph_rule: alternate +drift_delta and -drift_delta every period rounds, starting with + at round zero
action_and_fault_semantics.burst_rule: apply +drift_delta at start_round and -drift_delta at start_round+duration
action_and_fault_semantics.compound_rule: apply +drift_delta at change_round, an additional +drift_delta at burst_start, and -drift_delta at burst_start+burst_duration

seed_expansion.shared_and_logical_cells: reuse all 64 positional seeds across cells within a backend; each backend expands its own round-addressed RNG
seed_expansion.probe_cells: reuse the first 16 positional round seeds
seed_expansion.cutoff_convergence_cells: reuse the first 16 round-seed positions and first 8 trajectory-seed positions at cutoff 8 and 12
seed_expansion.cluster_receipt: each ledger row stores backend, absolute seed, seed_position, layer, cell_id, round_index and RNG namespace

cutoff_convergence_submatrix.gate_rule: A/B agreement is gated separately at each cutoff; within-backend cutoff 8-to-12 differences are gated on the same observable tolerances and reported separately from same-cutoff mapping
cutoff_convergence_submatrix.logical_capture_rule: captured probabilities and embedded projector movement are mandatory diagnostics and may not be described as converged merely because A/B agree at a fixed cutoff

estimands.ensemble_density_trace_distance: one half of the nuclear norm of the Hermitian difference between unconditional arithmetic-mean joint density matrices for the two backends in the same predeclared cell
estimands.mean_photon_difference: absolute difference of arithmetic means of Tr[n rho_osc] over the complete cell denominator
estimands.level_probability_l1: L1 distance between arithmetic-mean post-reset (g,e,f) probability vectors in fixed g,e,f order
estimands.integrated_iq_mean_difference: Euclidean norm of the difference between arithmetic-mean (integrated_I,integrated_Q) vectors
estimands.integrated_iq_covariance_frobenius: Frobenius norm of the difference between unbiased 2x2 sample covariance matrices of integrated I/Q
estimands.iq_two_sample_ks: maximum of the two standard two-sided empirical KS statistics computed separately for integrated I and integrated Q
estimands.log_evidence_mean_difference: absolute difference of arithmetic means of log_evidence_density
estimands.posterior_mean_l1: L1 distance between arithmetic-mean posterior vectors in fixed g,e,f order
estimands.logical_trace_decreasing_block: survival_probability multiplied by the frame-corrected 2x2 logical density; no projection-conditioned renormalization enters a main metric
estimands.logical_ptm: unconditional 4x4 Pauli transfer matrix reconstructed from ensemble means of the six trace-decreasing +/-X,+/-Y,+/-Z blocks; row/column order I,X,Y,Z
estimands.logical_ptm_entry_difference: maximum absolute entrywise A/B difference of the unconditional 4x4 logical PTMs
estimands.logical_survival_difference: absolute difference of arithmetic-mean survival probability for each logical-state/action cell
estimands.reset_success_rate_difference: absolute difference in hidden reset-success fractions over all and only reset-request rows; the denominator includes reset failures and is never postselected by ACK
estimands.leakage_residence_rate_difference: absolute difference in fractions of complete rows with post-round leakage_age greater than zero
estimands.short_trajectory_terminal_trace_distance: one half nuclear norm between unconditional arithmetic-mean terminal joint densities for a fault/cutoff cell
estimands.short_trajectory_observable_mean_differe: maximum absolute difference across terminal mean photon, g/e/f probabilities, integrated I/Q, log evidence, leakage residence, drift L2 norm and logical survival when available
estimands.conservation_pass_fraction: fraction of all expected rows whose density is finite, Hermitian Frobenius error <=5e-8, trace error <=5e-8, minimum eigenvalue >=-5e-8, posterior and level laws normalized <=5e-8, and no exception/missing field occurred
estimands.projector_frobenius: unnormalized Frobenius norm of P_A-P_B at the same cutoff
estimands.principal_singular: singular values of V_A^dagger V_B at the same cutoff, with V_A/V_B independently orthonormal

statistical_procedure.resampling_unit: seed_position cluster within backend and layer/denominator size
statistical_procedure.backend_sampling: resample A and B cluster positions independently with replacement; preserve all rows/cells/rounds attached to a selected position
statistical_procedure.cross_cell_dependence: use the same bootstrap position multiplicities for every cell sharing a layer and denominator size
statistical_procedure.cross_cutoff_dependence: use the same within-backend position multiplicities at cutoff 8 and cutoff 12
statistical_procedure.standard_error: sample standard deviation of the 2000 bootstrap estimand replicates with ddof=1
statistical_procedure.max_t_statistic: for every upper-bounded stochastic gate use abs(theta_star-theta_hat)/max(se,1e-12); take the maximum over all predeclared stochastic cells/metrics per replicate
statistical_procedure.critical_value: empirical 0.95 quantile using numpy method=higher of the 2000 maximum standardized deviations
statistical_procedure.upper_gate: pass iff simultaneous upper_bound <= frozen tolerance; equality passes
statistical_procedure.mapping_lower_gate: deterministic pass iff minimum principal singular value >=0.95; equality passes
statistical_procedure.mapping_upper_gate: deterministic pass iff projector Frobenius <=0.30; equality passes
statistical_procedure.conservation_gate: exact pass iff observed/expected rows are equal and conservation pass fraction >=1.0; no bootstrap rescue

gate_scope.shared_physical: every shared-state/action cell at cutoff 8 plus the full declared cutoff-confirmation subset at cutoff 12
gate_scope.representative_probes: all 16 T9.2.1 probes at cutoff 8; non-codebook and non-performance
gate_scope.logical: every logical-state/action survival cell and every action PTM at cutoff 8 plus the declared cutoff-confirmation subset at cutoff 12
gate_scope.fault: every scenario terminal and residence cell at cutoff 8 plus the declared cutoff-confirmation subset at cutoff 12
gate_scope.cutoff_within_backend: every predeclared confirmation cell and observable for backend A and backend B separately

failure_and_release_policy.scientific_fail_definition: complete finite formal denominator with at least one frozen main gate outside tolerance
failure_and_release_policy.infrastructure_fail_definition: any crash, exception, missing/nonfinite/corrupt cell, source-data mismatch, lineage mismatch or incomplete denominator
